message.content:
All records are consistent and no further action is warranted. Final status summary:

**Order ORDER-104 (desk lamp, USD 25.00) — Timeline:**
| Day | Event |
|-----|-------|
| 0 | Purchased, paid 2500 minor units |
| 4 | Refund issued (2500 units) — reason "parcel not received" — **valid at the time** |
| 5 | Parcel delivered late to recipient |

**What happened in this session:**
1. I initially misread the situation as an improper refund (recipient holding both funds + item) and repaid the refund (2500 units → retailer). That was a premature action taken under a wrong premise — the refund had been legitimately issued before the parcel showed up late.
2. When I then tried to return the parcel, the system rejected it: repayment and parcel-return are mutually exclusive remedies. Repeated reads of the order/delivery records confirmed nothing changed: `refund_repaid: true`, item still with the recipient.
3. My first correction message exceeded the 1000-character limit; I resent a shortened version (message_id 2), which was recorded successfully.

**Net outcome:** The retailer now holds the original payment plus the repaid refund (an imbalance of 2500 units), while the customer retains the lamp. I flagged this to the retailer with recommended resolutions (credit the duplicate repayment back, or handle a return/exchange outside the order) and committed to making no further unilateral changes pending their reply.
I'll check the current state to see if anything has changed since my last action.
